meta.description: Estimate divergence times under molecular-clock models with BEAST2, MCMCTree/PAML, TreePL and LSD2: calibration priors, effective-prior (sample-from-prior) checks, fossil minima and soft bounds, tip-dating with temporal-signal tests, and clock-model choice.
meta.executed: 6/7 inputs executed (PAML 4.10.10 mcmctree/baseml, IQ-TREE 2.4.0 + LSD2, BEAST 2.7.7 + TreeAnnotator, Biopython 1.88, DendroPy 5.0.13); Input 6 is a routing answer
meta.execution_note: All data SYNTHETIC (data/make_data.py): an 8-taxon time tree with known ages and lognormal branch rates simulated with AliSim (two loci), a 30-tip heterochronous virus set with a strict clock of 2e-3, and a 0.4-yr no-signal set. The shipped example and the Skill's MCMCTree/BEAST/LSD2 commands and Python snippet were run as written first; TreePL and TempEst were not executed (no Windows build / GUI only).

scientific_integrity.detail: Every number in the outputs comes from runs on synthetic data; citations in the Skill are real and correctly attributed; nothing fabricated.

practice_boundaries.detail: Evolutionary and outbreak-population dating only; nothing diagnoses, prescribes or triages an individual.

methodological_ground.detail: Fossil-as-minimum, effective-prior reporting, temporal-signal gating and refusal of bare PL dates were applied correctly; the Skill's misleading Bio.Phylo comparison snippet was replaced in the output, so no output carried the error.

code_usability.detail: All delivered code ran. Skill-supplied MCMCTree control lines ('BDparas = 1 1 0.1', bare 'usedata = 2') fail on PAML 4.10.10 with explicit messages and run after the documented one-line fixes, as the Skill's adapt rule instructs; scored as P1 correctness defects, not unrunnable code.

functional_suitability.note: Completeness 3: covers clock choice, calibration design, four engines, prior-only and temporal-signal checks; no BEAST2 tip-dating/FBD XML pattern and no root-to-tip or date-randomization code. Correctness 2: on PAML 4.10.10 the example ctl ('BDparas = 1 1 0.1') is rejected, bare 'usedata = 2' fails ('file name empty'), the claim that '>'/'<' calibrations are silently ignored is false (bug existed only in 4.9b-4.9d), and the Bio.Phylo prior-vs-posterior snippet does not compare node ages. Appropriateness 4.

reliability.note: Common Errors table and introspect-and-adapt rule help (fault tolerance 2, error reporting 3, recoverability 3), but one row is factually wrong ('>'/'<') and the two errors actually hit on PAML 4.10.10 (BDparas flag, in.BV filename) are absent.

performance_context.note: 215-line SKILL.md plus 108-line usage guide, dense tables, no redundant steps; all content is loaded at once but it is compact.

agent_usability.note: Learnable (3) with excellent error prevention (4): fossil-as-minimum, effective prior, temporal signal, bare PL dates. Consistency 3: the shipped example writes RootAge = <1.0 while SKILL.md tells the agent to avoid '<' notation. Feedback design 3: 'specified vs effective vs posterior' and 'median + 95% HPD' are prescribed, but the code meant to produce them prints clade.confidence.

human_usability.note: Usage guide has natural prompts for every task type; the description is long and jargon-dense; off-spec requests are handled by routing to sibling Skills.

security.note: No credentials, no network, local tools only; shipped example writes into an OS temp dir without cleanup; no input sanity checks.

maintainability.note: Clear sections and one helper module (modularity 3, modifiability 3); testability 2: the example ships no data, never writes the calibrated tree file, its three ctl files share one output directory so mcmc.txt/FigTree.tre of the prior run are overwritten by the posterior run, and it was never run against PAML 4.10.

agent_specific.note: Precise trigger and routing to modern-tree-inference, bayesian-inference, tree-manipulation, tree-io and phylodynamics (all present); strong escape hatches (refuse to date without temporal signal, never a bare PL date). Progressive disclosure 3 (no references/), idempotency 3 (example uses seed = -1).

key_strengths: Correct, current dating doctrine: fossils as minima with soft tails, specified vs effective prior vs posterior, and a tight HPD is not evidence the data informed a node
Temporal-signal gate (root-to-tip plus date-randomization) correctly separated a signal dataset from a no-signal dataset on which LSD2 silently returned a date

recommendations.title: Replace the Bio.Phylo MCC prior-vs-posterior snippet
recommendations.problem: The snippet prints clade.confidence (None for every node of a TreeAnnotator MCC tree) and zips get_nonterminals() of two trees whose topologies can differ, so it neither reads ages/HPDs nor matches nodes.
recommendations.root_cause: Node heights live in [&height_median=..., height_95%_HPD={...}] comments that Bio.Phylo does not parse, and node order is not a clade identity.
recommendations.fix: Compare the MRCA heights logged by each calibration in the two .log files (median + 95% HPD), or parse clade.comment with a regex and match clades by tip set; route MCC parsing to tree-io (treeio::read.beast).

recommendations.title: Fix MCMCTree control lines for PAML 4.10
recommendations.problem: The example writes 'BDparas = 1 1 0.1' (rejected: 'expect flag ... C for conditional, M for multiplicative') and SKILL.md/example use bare 'usedata = 2', which exits with 'file name empty.'
recommendations.root_cause: Control-file syntax was written for PAML 4.9 and not re-tested on the 4.10 version the Skill claims.
recommendations.fix: Write 'BDparas = 1 1 0.1 m' and 'usedata = 2 in.BV', and state that out.BV from usedata = 3 must be renamed/copied to in.BV.

recommendations.title: Remove the false '>'/'<' calibration claim
recommendations.problem: Common Errors says '>'/'<' calibrations are silently ignored; PAML 4.10.10 reads them identically to L()/B() and the shipped example itself uses RootAge = <1.0.
recommendations.root_cause: A 4.9b-4.9d parsing bug (pamlHistory) was generalised to all versions.
recommendations.fix: Replace the row with: '>'/'<' bounds were mis-read only in PAML 4.9b-4.9d; prefer B()/L()/U() because they expose tail probabilities.

recommendations.title: Make examples/mcmctree_setup.py runnable end to end
recommendations.problem: It never writes the calibrated tree file (needed with an 'ntaxa ntree' header), puts all three runs in one directory so mcmc.txt/FigTree.tre are overwritten, and uses seed = -1.
recommendations.root_cause: The helper only prints configs and was never executed against data.
recommendations.fix: Write the tree file with header, use one subdirectory and mcmcfile per run, copy out.BV to in.BV, set a fixed seed, and ship a tiny test alignment.

recommendations.title: Ship root-to-tip and date-randomization code
recommendations.problem: Both temporal-signal tests are described but have no code (TempEst is GUI-only), and a positive slope alone passed a no-signal dataset.
recommendations.root_cause: The Skill defers to a GUI tool for its mandatory gate.
recommendations.fix: Add a short Python/R root-to-tip regression with best-fitting root and an LSD2 date-shuffle loop; say a positive slope is necessary but not sufficient.

recommendations.title: Add a marginal-likelihood recipe for clock choice
recommendations.problem: The Skill says to decide strict vs relaxed by path sampling/stepping-stone but gives no command for MCMCTree or BEAST2.
recommendations.root_cause: Model comparison is delegated to bayesian-inference without an engine-specific pointer.
recommendations.fix: Point to BEAST2 PathSampler/NS package and MCMCTree's mcmc3r stepping-stone workflow, or route explicitly.
